38145191.population: 1,857 community residents initially free of dementia in the Shanghai Aging Study
38145191.measure: Baseline plasma p-tau217, p-tau181 and NfL
38145191.outcome: Incident dementia and AD, cognitive decline and later amyloid status

42009653.population: 233 participants across five diagnostic groups in a Chinese cohort
42009653.measure: Plasma p-tau217 measured with three novel assays and a reference assay
42009653.outcome: Alzheimer’s dementia versus cognitively unimpaired controls and non-AD dementia
42009653.finding: All three novel assays distinguished Alzheimer’s dementia from controls and non-AD dementia in this cohort. Diagnostic performance did not differ significantly between the three assays.
